subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------ATTN.
description: Chart on book p. 378 (R(AS)CM(II)-22). INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the subject; ATTN (attraction) is the partner. From the subject: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), ACT (activism) and C-INFO (composite information). From VT-DY: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From ACT: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From C-INFO: AFI (affinity insight) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From COS-P: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies).
